Project Spotlight: Scaling Analytics with Materialized Views

As a Lead Data Engineer at Tata Consultancy Services, I worked on a project that involved optimizing our analytics workloads on Redshift and Databricks SQL. Our goal was to improve query performance and reduce costs for our healthcare client.

The challenge we faced was that their data warehouse was experiencing slow query performance due to complex joins and aggregations on large datasets. This resulted in frustrated business users and delayed decision-making.

To address this issue, we implemented materialized views (MVs) in both Redshift and Databricks SQL. In Redshift, we used the `CREATE MATERIALIZED VIEW` command to pre-aggregate data, and in Databricks SQL, we leveraged Delta Lake to create optimized MVs using `CREATE MATERIALIZED VIEW` with `delta`.

By implementing MVs, we reduced query latency by 30% and achieved a 25% reduction in costs. Specifically, we saw a decrease from 10 mins to 3 mins in query execution time for our most complex analytics queries.

The impact was significant, enabling business users to make data-driven decisions faster and more efficiently. I'm excited to share that our approach has been adopted across multiple clients, and I'm looking forward to bringing this expertise to the healthcare and biotech industries.
